_comment: The adopted Siamsil Zomi Standard Form (docs/ZOMI_STANDARD_FORM.md, steps 4-5). Rules belong here when two different reviewer codes are in approved_by, or when the creator adopted them alone under the governance block (adopted_by 'creator'). Each needs the date and the reason. AI suggestions in rule_checks.json and the review workbook are never copied here unreviewed. Applied by ml_pipeline/scripts/zolai_standard.py, which keeps every original text and stores the standard form beside it. mode 'replace' writes the standard spelling; mode 'flag' only lists the match, for spellings whose meaning depends on context. Bump the version when rules change: minor for new rules, major for a changed or removed rule.

rules.owner_words: I want to use as the Bible uh hi
rules.reason: The project owner chose the Bibles' spelling, two words, because 'uh' marks the plural and 'hi' is the verb (owner_example). This also follows the Standard Form tie-break (common published usage first).

rules.owner_words: if you see "thil", replace with "na", etc
rules.reason: The project owner asked for 'thil' to be written 'na'.

rules.owner_words: yes, that is the correct one
rules.reason: The question form of P-001: 'uh' marks the plural and 'hiam' is the question verb. The two-word form is already the main spelling in the corpus.

governance.decided_by: project owner (original creator of the Siamsil Zomi Standard Form)
governance.owner_words: use the rule, because this is my reviewed and my ownership even though it changed many and it will get better quality sentence paired
governance.note: Recorded as the owner's own decision. A rule with adopted_by 'creator' was adopted by the creator alone, without two reviewer codes; it is not a Language Review Team approval and no pair is marked reviewed because of it. A rule can be changed or removed by the same owner decision.
